title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Bounded Emergency Autonomy Without Quorum Extension

new_primitives.EMERGENCY_CAPABILITY_ID: Predeclared capability permitting a narrow local safety action without global authority renewal.
new_primitives.EMERGENCY_SCOPE: Exact local resource and action class that may be affected.
new_primitives.NECESSITY_CHECK: Evaluation that delay creates immediate local harm and the selected action is no broader than necessary.
new_primitives.PENDING_LOCAL_EFFECT_RECEIPT: Receipt retained locally until it can be reconciled into the healed host history.

core_rule: Absence of quorum removes shared-world authority but does not automatically remove every pre-authorized local safety capability.
anti_escalation_rule: Emergency capability never mints a new authority epoch and cannot be converted into a general exception to fencing.
verification_requirements: prove fail-safe action succeeds without advancing authority epoch
attempt to label unrelated global action as emergency and reject
reconcile pending local receipt after connectivity returns
prove local fail-safe cannot spend a shared exclusive resource
canonical_lines: Emergency autonomy is a capability boundary, not an authority shortcut.
Safety under partition may require a narrow action while still forbidding a broad commit.
The smaller the authority, the stronger the claim that an emergency stayed local.
